coordinateSystem.origin: top left in normalized and image coordinates
sourceEvidenceFacts: Index module declares BoundLength=187.5, bounds=[[0,0],[187.5,187.5]], CRS.Simple; passes coordinates split by comma through helper before rendering.
cursor helper maps source value using floor(value*(boundLength/256)*100)/100.

limitations: This tool exposes one world area only; no local town/dungeon map layers.
Unlocated rows have no usable coordinates and are preserved separately. Never plot them at guessed positions.
Marker url fields are blank in source; sourcePage is attribution and verification link.
Raw marker titles/descriptions/item names are Japanese source data. No translations were invented.
